description: This file implements classes and functions related to blocking IPC closures, including factory methods for creating blocking closure objects, and specific implementations for poll-based and semaphore-based blocking closures within the firebolt::rialto::ipc namespace.

classes.name: IBlockingClosureFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating blocking closure objects.

classes.name: BlockingClosureFactory
classes.description: Factory class implementing creation of blocking closure objects.

classes.name: BlockingClosurePoll
classes.description: Implementation of a blocking closure that uses polling on an IPC channel.

classes.name: BlockingClosureSemaphore
classes.description: Implementation of a blocking closure that uses a semaphore for synchronization.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new BlockingClosureFactory instance.

methods.name: createBlockingClosurePoll
methods.description: Creates a blocking closure that polls on the provided IPC channel.

methods.name: createBlockingClosureSemaphore
methods.description: Creates a blocking closure that uses a semaphore for blocking.

methods.name: BlockingClosurePoll::Run
methods.description: Sets the internal done flag to true, signaling the poll to stop.

methods.name: BlockingClosurePoll::wait
methods.description: Waits on the IPC channel, processing messages until the closure is marked done.

methods.name: BlockingClosureSemaphore::Run
methods.description: Signals the semaphore to unblock any waiting threads.

methods.name: BlockingClosureSemaphore::wait
methods.description: Waits on the semaphore until it is signaled.
